description: VIN decode: manufacturer (WMI), model year, check digit — Decodes up to 50 VINs per call for an agent handling a vehicle listing, claim or order: validates the 17 characters and letters I/O/Q, the position-9 check digit (49 CFR 565.15), the world manufacturer identifier from a bundled NHTSA vPIC snapshot, and the model year from position 10. Position 10 repeats every 30 years: pass vehicleClass light (position 7 resolves the century) or asOf, otherwise b

asOf.description: Reference date (YYYY-MM-DD) used to drop model years more than one year after it. No clock is read.

vehicleClass.description: light: passenger car, MPV or truck up to 4536 kg GVWR (position 7 fixes the model-year century). other: all other vehicles.

name: vin-decode
